attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 (Alpine Linux) to log every sudo command with user and timestamp to /var/log/sudo-commands.log via a sudoers.d drop-in (Defaults logfile=..., log_year, log_host, !syslog), keeping entries out of the general syslog/messages log. Verified logging works and confirmed no leakage into /var/log/messages, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted via sudo, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed the sudoers config, prior log content, and continued correct logging behavior all survived the restart.
